svg.title: Project 11: artistic mask
svg.text: Trace the gray mask, lace and filigree, or use it as a guide for your own shape. Keep the almond around each eye bare. Lesson 09.2.
Must measure 10 cm. If not, print at 100% ("Actual size").
Gray dots: gem places (forehead and temple tips only). Dashed lines: feather shafts.
Red dotted ovals: eye area. The mask edge stays outside them; no gems or glitter near the lashes.
